note: Work: 16. Employment Order, 2009 (S 37, gazetted 5 September 2009, made under Article 83(3) of the Constitution; read in the gazette text the ASEAN Inter-Parliamentary Assembly's legal network (aipalync.org) holds, the Attorney General's Chambers' own copy answering 404 and its archive.org snapshot not fetching): s. 9(1), a person under 16 can't enter a contract of service; s. 9(2), from 16 to 18 only in an occupation the Commissioner approves as not injurious to youths (not held). A 'child' is under 15; s. 103 bars employing a child in any undertaking except a family industrial one, and lets a child of 14 do light work suited to capacity outside industry (not held). Later amendments and the revised Laws of Brunei text (Employment Act, Cap. 278) weren't compared. Performers: barred, the reading being that the Order has no exception for performers. Majority: null; Brunei's age of majority law wasn't found in an official copy (a web search found only an unsourced site saying 18, 2026-10-31). Service: null; no conscription or defence law was read.
